name: Chess
description: A position, and the move to find. A whole line works too: the board plays the replies.

fields.label: Position (FEN)
fields.hint: Copy it from Lichess or chess.com (Share, then FEN). The side to move plays the answer.

fields.label: Answer
fields.hint: The move to find, like Nf3. Or a line, like Nf3 Nc6 Bb5: your moves and the replies between them.
